name: Semantic version comparison
text: Compare major, then minor, then patch components as integers. Return the exact newer version.

name: ISO date comparison
text: For YYYY-MM-DD dates, compare year, then month, then day. Return the exact later date.

name: Lower latency selection
text: Compare latency values in the same unit and choose the named option with the smaller value.

name: Higher capacity selection
text: Compare capacities in the same unit and choose the named option with the larger value.

name: Latest revision selection
text: Compare integer revision numbers and choose the document with the largest revision.

name: Threshold classification
text: Classify a measurement as high only when it is greater than or equal to the stated threshold.

name: Schedule overlap check
text: Two closed time intervals overlap when the later start is not after the earlier end.

name: Trusted-current policy precedence
text: Prefer a trusted current policy over an older superseded policy. Abstain when equally trusted current policies conflict.
